Home About Seacoast Plastic Surgery And Medical Aesthetics Seacoast Plastic Surgery (SPS) is located in Portsmouth, NH, and is led by board-certified Plastic Surgeon Dr. Alexander Slocum. His Aesthetic practice focuses on Rhinoplasty , Facelift body contouring , and Breast Rejuvenation procedures. In addition, he offers patients the full spectrum of Reconstructive and General Plastic Surgery. More To Offer Non-Surgical Treatments For patients seeking non-surgical treatments, our team of experts have cultivated a comprehensive offering of evidence-based, state-of-the-art Aesthetic Medicine services. With a focus on quality, honesty, and reliability, we are focused on providing each patient with a world-class experience, while working closely with them to ensure that they can achieve their goals. Our dedicated team caters to each patient as an individual, to help ensure a smooth journey towards feeling rejuvenated and confident in their own skin. SPS Expertise Why Choose Us? Alexander Slocum, Jr, MD/PhD, FACS, is a board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon with a passion for superior results. A New Hampshire native, Dr Slocum earned his bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral degrees in mechanical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). His PhD thesis created a new rolling-contact knee joint, and he holds several patents related to precision machines and medical devices. After attending medical school at the Joan C. Edwards School of Medicine at Marshall University in West Virginia, he completed surgical training at Harvard University/Brigham and Women’s Hospital and an integrated plastic surgery residency at the Medical College of Wisconsin.
